concerns.text: FR-001 specifies the dataset URL as `https://osf.io/3k9r2/` while the Assumptions section and Constitution (FR-030) refer to `https://osf.io/k9r2/`. This contradictory reference creates ambiguity about which dataset should be downloaded, violating internal consistency.

FR-001 lists required columns `scf_self_judgment` and `scf_self_kindness`, but later requirements (e.g., FR-014) and the narrative refer to the SCS‑Self‑Kindness subscale using the prefix `scs_`. The mismatched column prefixes (`scf_` vs `scs_`) are inconsistent and would cause the pipeline to fail when locating the expected data fields.
